scientific.integrity: The linear threshold already follows from the 2021 predecessor after parameter sign conversion; originality is claimed only for the explicit cubic-family Hopf coefficient, branch side/stability, and degenerate surface.
limitations: The periodic-orbit conclusion is local for sufficiently small |beta| near beta=0.
No claim is made that the local branch persists to the finite beta values used in the source numerical figures.
The surface 8 alpha^2 - 13 alpha + 15 gamma - 1 = 0 requires higher-order analysis.

title: Explicit Hopf criticality surface for a cubic jerk flow
